fieldValues.title: Problem held-by points to persona-in-domain
fieldValues.decision_question: What does a problem's held-by point at, and how is its domain known?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner's local planning session on 2026-10-11 (clerk#32), walked one decision at a time; awaiting the owner's ratification in a clerk session.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered: (a) keep held-by to the shared persona; (b) held-by to persona-in-domain.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Take (b): held-by points to persona-in-domain. A problem's domain is derived through held-by then in-domain. Domain container membership is arrangement only. Unwalked domains keep held-by to the shared persona, reported as a warning.
fieldValues.rationale: The domain follows from the persona in that domain, so membership of a container carries no meaning.
